purpose: Exploratory brand moodboards, not approved product designs. All imagery generated. UI readings illustrative.

directions.name: Quiet Instrument
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished high-resolution LANDSCAPE branding MOODBOARD IMAGE for Bloom, a Windows desktop notch companion integrated at the CENTER of the MyFinder top menu bar, helping a person coding with multiple AI agents glance at their usage and resets. This is a concept moodboard, not a website, slide deck or app screenshot. The app name remains "Bloom". Strong editorial art direction, aligned edges, intentional typography, photographic material studies and beautifully composed application mockup. All work must look convincingly designed, not generic AI SaaS. No violet, lavender, purple, chrome blobs, robots, floating 3D cubes, Apple logos or invented testimonials. No watermark. Use a visually balanced collage with 5-7 intentional areas: large Bloom wordmark/type specimen; short numbered direction name and three emotion words; 2 macro material/atmosphere photography studies; 5 large palette swatches with exact hex labels; and one LARGE clearly visible flat front-on desktop application study, about 40% of the board, in desktop context. Not an isometric monitor or laptop. Product invariants for application study: slim MyFinder menu strip with readable File, Edit, View at left and tiny system controls at right; a NARROW OPAQUE MATTE BLACK centered housing equal to bar height, with concise status and clock INSIDE the housing. Its expanded opaque matte black panel is wider ONLY BELOW THE MENU STRIP, so the strip and neighboring menus are unobscured, a narrow neck connecting wider panel beneath. Concave shoulders, softly rounded bottom corners, no glass, glow, transparency or giant rounded dashboard cards in the product UI. Expanded panel has three flat horizontal quota rows with labels Claude, Codex, Cursor, short green/amber usage bars and illustrative 42%, 76%, 28% values next to label, resets right-aligned. Footer exact words "Just checked". Use text names rather than fabricated provider logos. Operational UI typography stays compact readable Inter-like sans with aligned tabular numerals; expressive display type belongs to moodboard wordmark only. Do not change green/amber/red semantic quota colors to the brand accent. Small label "Concept / illustrative readings" discretely placed ON the board. This board should communicate how the product FEELS, not just a generic swatch grid. Photography should feel like commissioned editorial still life, no stock office teams. All lettering clean and legible.
DIRECTION 01: "QUIET INSTRUMENT". Emotional words exactly: "Precise. Discreet. Composed." A crisp industrial Swiss instrument/editorial world, restrained monochrome with a single pale technical blue outside the semantic data. Museum-quality understated precision. Broad off-white board ground with strong black wordmark "Bloom" in a refined neutral grotesk, meticulous baseline and generous negative space. Structure: large editorial wordmark upper left, macro-photo of satin brushed aluminum and a black anodized seam upper right, pale grey technical lines and one thin measuring detail; large application study anchored across lower left/center over a cool light grey desktop; swatches and tabular type specimen aligned right. Physical scene is daylight at a meticulous designer-developer's desk. Materials: satin aluminum, optical black, frosted mineral. Palette exact: #000000, #191B1E, #AEB5BD, #F1F3F4, #A7D9ED. One subtle original Bloom aperture-like wordmark detail permitted, no full new logo suite. UI is MATTE BLACK. Avoid sci-fi, excessive rules, tiny unreadable text. Warm human confidence through clarity, premium utility.
